headline: Fastest in program history at Woodward Park
body: The girls ran the fastest team time in Monte Vista history on the Woodward Park course on Saturday, finishing sixth overall and first among Division 2 schools. Kaylie O'Connell, Nadya Makarova and Ava Padilla each put a run into the school's all-time top five on that course.
